headline: Small SE swell on a prime angle — early log-only affair.
today: Barely waist-high but it's a prime angle and the NE cross-off keeps the morning tidy. Log or groveler on the early incoming, because the afternoon E cross at 14mph will chop it up. Fun-size at best, skip if you need push.

daysToWatch.note: Biggest day of the week to near 3.8ft on a good SSE angle, but cross wind all day keeps it textured. Worth a surf, manage expectations.
Chest-high good-angle swell with NE cross-off through the morning — cleanest window of the week. Get it before the afternoon ESE cross-on.
Light SE wind and near-glass early with 2.5-3ft at 6.5s — dawn patrol before the midday S onshore kills it.
